text: {"393":{"about":["rustc_lexer","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"The compiler's initial conversion of source text into compiler-friendly syntax data is implemented by lexing and parsing."},"394":{"about":["rustc_lexer","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"Lexing into tokens is rustc_lexer's role, while parsing token streams is rustc_parse's role."},"395":{"about":["rustc_lexer"],"refers":[],"why":"The example describes the tokenization behavior performed by the lexer."},"396":{"about":["rustc_lexer","rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_lexer produces low-level tokens and rustc_parse parses token streams into an AST."},"397":{"about":["rustc_ast","rustc_span"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines the AST nodes, whose spans use rustc_span's source-location representation to connect nodes to source text."}}
